timing: After the eight-window 74-question two-action diagnostic left a bounded maximum only .02105 above terminal PPO, ask whether the already measured relation skill increases achievable performance on the same matched terminal decisions. This is a hindsight feasibility diagnostic, not a deployable policy. No independent target scores are used.
population: Keep all 25 registered terminal-pivot windows and all unmatched exclusions. On available matched windows use their checked, shared-prefix temporal/activity/relation F1 endpoints; deploy one set of probabilities per session, shared by every question. Report the incremental value of the third action on exactly the same windows and per history. Also separate the originally reserved later sessions from the calibration donor windows.
bounds: For two actions report the best fixed action per window and the best corner of +/-2 around the native activity-to-temporal log odds. For three actions report the best fixed action per window, best softmax corner when both native log odds can each change by +/-2, and best of that three-action family or the two-action family if relation can be disabled in a window. Maximizing a linear-fractional objective over positive odds intervals occurs at a corner. Use mean per-window returns for the maximization, then aggregate by question count. Report the advantage of the best single global constant over all windows separately from the gain from choosing a different action per window.
